get.summary: Get all Job Titles in the Company
get.description: Returns an array of all Job Titles within the specified company.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for the company. This parameter accepts both formats:
- **Recommended**: Procore company ID (integer) - Use this for new integrations
- Legacy: LaborChart UUID format (uuid string) - Supported for backward compatibility

A proxy layer automatically handles both formats, but using the Procore company ID is preferred for consistency with other Procore APIs.

schema.description: Returns an array of Job Title objects.

items.description: Schema representing a single Job Title.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Job Title.

group_ids.description: List of Group UUIDs where this Job Title is available.

globally_accessible.description: Controls whether the Job Title is globally available to all current and future Groups.

color.description: Hexadecimal color code for the Job Title. Helps with categorization and visual distinction.

type.description: Specifies the Job Title type. - `hourly` - Hourly wage-based job title. - `salaried` - Fixed salary job title.

hourly_rate.description: Hourly wage rate for the Job Title. Required if type is `hourly`.

error.description: If you receive a 401 error, please ensure you are following the OAuth 2.0 guidelines outlined at https://developers.procore.com/documentation/introduction and verify you can successfully call the /me endpoint using your access token. Additionally, the user associated with that token must be added as a user in the Workforce Planning People List for the corresponding company.

schema.description: Request body schema for creating a new Job Title.

name.description: The name of the Job Title.

group_ids.description: Array of UUIDs for which Groups this Job Title should be available to. If `globally_accessible` is set to `true`, this value can be an empty array.

globally_accessible.description: Controls whether the Job Title should be globally available to all current and future Groups.

color.description: Hexadecimal color code for the Job Title. Helps with categorization and visual distinction.

type.description: Indicates whether the Job Title is salaried or hourly.

hourly_rate.description: The rate value that will be factored into cost calculations for any person who has this job title applied and doesn't already have a standalone hourly wage value. This is also handy for costing manpower requests when job titles are specified.

schema.description: Schema for a Job Title ID response.

id.description: The unique identifier of the Job Title.

Additionally, the user associated with that token must be added as a user in the Workforce Planning People List for the corresponding company.
